facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alice saw a white rabbit. She followed it into a hole. She fell down very deep. Alice fell down.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice was sitting by the river with her sister one boring day. Suddenly a white rabbit wearing a coat ran past her quickly. The rabbit was shouting that he was late for something important. Alice fell down after the rabbit into a very deep dark hole. She fell and fell for what seemed like a very long time. When she landed, she was in a strange and wonderful place.
facts.Word cards: rabbit = 토끼 / hole = 구멍 / fell down = 떨어졌다 / deep = 깊은
